newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Kuchma asks Ukraine parl't for strategic sell-off.
newsitem.headline: Kuchma asks Ukraine parl't for strategic sell-off.

text.p: President Leonid Kuchma on Wednesday asked Urkraine's parliament to privatise strategic enterprises and overturn a ban on tax breaks for foreign investors imposed in April.

Kuchma said in a written address to parliament that a controlling share in businesses with strategic significance should be handed to non-state economic entities for five years in return for payment of a "deposit" which would be used to help fund the budget deficit.
He said tax breaks for foreigners "could offer tax holidays and temporary liberation from customs and other duties."
He said unprofitable enterprises should immediately undergo checks -- a move which could eventually lead to bankruptcy.
He said privatisation had to be speeded up and moved from voucher privatisation to cash sell-offs to attract not only domestic but foreign investors.

Kuchma wrote that the tax burden should be almost halved from its 1996 levels and asked parliament to reduce payments to Ukraine's wages fund to 38 percent in 1998 and 28 percent in 1999 from 48.5 percent of salaries now.
